title: INT8 weight-only quant profile integration: canary cascade and regression harness
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Integrate INT8 weight-only (GPTQ/AWQ) quantization profiles into the main inference pipeline and provide a canary cascade and regression harness to validate accuracy and detect numerical drift. This ticket covers: profile packaging, kernel compatibility checks, calibration snapshot playback, golden-answer regression gating, and canary rollout orchestration across dedicated and hosted backends.
acceptance_criteria: Packaged INT8 weight-only profiles (GPTQ and AWQ variants) are available in the profile registry and can be consumed by runtime-config without code changes
Canary cascade executes on a subset of runtime fleet across three failure domains (region, hardware family, model variant) with automatic rollback on delta > threshold
Regression harness runs nightly and produces a golden-answer delta report (token-level and semantic metrics) with historical retention for 30 days
Calibration snapshots can be replayed deterministically in CI to reproduce canary failures locally
Telemetry events include profile_id, quantizer_type, hw_family, kernel_variant, and per-request answer_delta so we can correlate regressions to profiles and hardware
implementation_steps: Extend profile registry schema to include 'quantizer: gptq|awq' and 'compat_kernels' fields
Add runtime adapter to translate profile into kernel selection hints and prefix/KV cache plumbing
Create calibration playback CLI to feed saved snapshots into the CI harness (s3://redwood-int8-calibrations/)
Implement canary cascade job in orchestration: small-percentage -> mid -> wide, with automatic metrics gating
Wire telemetry anchors into observability: dashboard widget and alert rule for mean answer_delta > 0.5 over 1h
progress_updates: 2025-02-20: Initial spike completed — verified GPTQ and AWQ artifacts can be loaded by a local runtime build. Found a kernel mismatch on A100-80GB; started spec to add kernel tags.
2025-02-24: Prototype calibration playback tool implemented (python CLI). Successfully replayed two saved calibration snapshots and reproduced a 0.4 BLEU regression in local smoke run.
2025-02-28: Telemetry schema proposed. Working with observability (Sanjay) to add profile_id and kernel_variant to per-request spans.
2025-03-03: Canary cascade flow drafted in orchestration repo (PR #1342). Needs approval from infra and runtime reviewers. Added canary rollback thresholds to 0.6 answer_delta default.
2025-03-05: Nightly regression job configured in CircleCI -> moved to runner with GPU quota. First night run scheduled for 2025-03-06.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Kernel incompatibilities across hardware families causing false positives in canary. Mitigation: Add per-hw golden baseline and require cross-hw agreement before rollback.
Risk: Telemetry cardinality explosion if profile IDs are too granular. Mitigation: Add derived 'profile_family' tag and sample detailed telemetry only for canary traffic.
Risk: Calibration playback non-determinism due to RNG seeds. Mitigation: Snapshot RNG seed and environment spec in calibration artifact metadata.
notes: Design decision: We will not automatically convert GPTQ->AWQ; both variants are treated as first-class profiles and must declare compatible kernel sets.

Trade-off: Running full golden-answer regression on every canary step is expensive; chosen approach is to run a light token-level delta check during cascade and trigger full semantic eval only if token delta crosses 0.4.
Follow-up: Add a 'shadow-run' mode where unmirrored production traffic is replayed through the quantized path for 7 days to collect field deltas before canary rollout.
